Polytheists, witnessing against themselves with disbelief, may not maintain Allah's mosques; only those who believe in Allah and the Last Day, pray, give zakah and fear only Allah should.
The polytheists are unclean and may not approach al-Masjid al-Haram after this year; if believers fear poverty, Allah will enrich them from His bounty if He wills.
Do not pray in a mosque taken for harm, disbelief and division; one founded on righteousness from the first day is worthier, unlike a building on a crumbling bank.
In mosques Allah ordered raised, men exalt Him morning and evening, undistracted by commerce from His remembrance, prayer and zakah, fearing the Day, and Allah rewards them from His bounty.
